_comments.security: No secrets in this file. GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN, JIRA_URL, JIRA_USERNAME and JIRA_API_TOKEN are inherited from the environment exported by the runner scripts (which read them from the macOS keychain). Never inline a PAT or API token here.
_comments.jira: Single Jira server via mcp-atlassian (token auth, no OAuth browser step). The agents call jira_get_issue / jira_search / jira_add_comment / jira_create_issue, so those must NOT be in disabledTools.
_comments.gitlab: Top-level server named 'Gitlab' — the agents reference it as @Gitlab. A GitLab server registered under the IDE 'powers' block is NOT addressable by kiro-cli agents, so this entry is required even if you already use the GitLab power.
_comments.merging: If you already have an mcp.json, deploy.sh will NOT overwrite it. Merge these entries into your existing mcpServers instead of adding duplicate Jira/GitLab servers.
